title: Console backend: add model changelog endpoints (feature-flagged + tier-gated)
author: Chloe Martin
description: Adds the Console backend endpoints required by the new “Changelog” tab on model + version pages. Endpoints are feature-flagged (console_model_changelog) and additionally gated by account tier (internal + selected enterprise beta accounts) so we can roll out safely before GA. The API only returns customer-visible/published changelog entries (draft/in_review excluded) and enforces RBAC at the Console boundary (no bypassing approval workflow). Includes pagination, basic filtering, and stable ordering by published_at,event_id to avoid UI jitter. Motivation: unblock Console UI (DES-211) while keeping the generator/publishing pipeline behind controlled exposure; reduces support confusion during rollouts by giving customers a canonical, linkable history per model/version.
commits: console/api: add changelog routes + request/response DTOs
console/authz: account-tier + feature-flag gating for changelog endpoints
console/service: integrate control-plane changelog store client w/ pagination
tests: add handler tests + authz matrix + pagination ordering fixtures
api_notes: New endpoints (Console): GET /console/v1/models/{model_id}/changelog?limit=&cursor=&from=&to= ; GET /console/v1/model-versions/{version_id}/changelog?limit=&cursor= . Behavior: if feature flag is off OR account not entitled => 404 (to avoid leaking existence of beta functionality); if entitled but no published entries => 200 with empty list. Only published entries are returned; entries are ordered by published_at desc then event_id desc. Cursors are opaque base64 tokens derived from (published_at,event_id) tuple.
implementation_details: Routing: handlers live in console-backend and call ChangelogService which wraps the control-plane client introduced in PR #18805. Gating: middleware checks (1) feature flag console_model_changelog evaluated per-account, (2) entitlements requiring account_tier in {enterprise_beta, internal} OR explicit allowlist override, and (3) standard Console RBAC (viewer can read; no write routes in this PR). Filtering: date range (from/to) validated as RFC3339; max window 365d; limit capped at 100. Ordering: service requests are normalized to deterministic sort so repeated refreshes and pagination don’t re-order entries when multiple publishes occur same day. Error model: 404 for disabled/not-entitled; 400 for invalid query params; 502 for upstream control-plane errors; all errors include request_id and are logged with account_id + model_id/version_id.
snippet: Example gate (simplified): if (!flags.isEnabled('console_model_changelog', ctx.accountId)) return res.status(404).json({code:'not_found'}); if (!entitlements.canAccessChangelog(ctx.account)) return res.status(404).json({code:'not_found'});
conversation: Dylan Brooks: Can we confirm this only exposes published entries? Also please avoid returning 403 for non-entitled accounts; 404 is preferable for beta surfaces. Chloe Martin: Confirmed — service requests status=published only; draft/in_review never returned. Switched to 404 for both flag-off and not-entitled. Jada Williams: Cursor semantics need to be stable; please make ordering deterministic when multiple entries share published_at. Chloe Martin: Added secondary ordering on event_id and included it in cursor token; added tests for same-day publishes. Brian Murphy: Any concerns about customers inferring internal model IDs via the changelog? Chloe Martin: These routes are Console-authenticated and only show models already visible in the catalog for that account; we also validate model_id existence within catalog visibility before calling changelog service. Jordan Lee: Please document the allowlist override path and make sure it’s auditable. Chloe Martin: Added notes to internal runbook pointer and a structured log field entitlement_reason={tier,allowlist}. Approvals: Dylan + Jada approved after changes; Brian approved with minor naming nit.
checks: CI: build-console-backend (pass); unit-tests (pass); lint (pass); openapi-diff (pass); integration-smoke-staging (pass).
testing: Added route-level handler tests covering: feature flag off => 404; tier not entitled => 404; entitled + no entries => 200 empty; pagination returns stable ordering; invalid from/to rejected; upstream 5xx mapped to 502 with request_id. Manually verified in staging with internal account against seeded fixtures (3 entries across 2 versions).
rollout_plan: Land behind console_model_changelog flag default-off. Enable for internal accounts immediately, then enable for enterprise beta allowlist (per PM rollout plan). Console UI will call these endpoints only when flag is on; otherwise changelog tab remains hidden.
